हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: Naina Prabhu, mocked for her looks and simplicity, is humiliated by the elite but finds strength under the mentorship of a fallen fashion icon. What begins as betrayal transforms into fierce redemption, as Naina reinvents herself and stuns the very world that once scorned her. A gripping tale of ambition, identity, and revenge—this is not just a makeover, it’s a reckoning.
